messages:
Maya: FYI getting a bunch of customer reports that pages aren't hitting mobile. started ~20:31 UTC. some customers got emails but no page. :(
Simon: @Maya seen any errors in the notify logs?
Maya: quick grep shows a lot of 413 /v1/pages responses from notify-router and the downstream pager-proxy. looks like payload too large.
Alex (SRE): i'm on it — i'm seeing repeated 413s. sample log: 
```
Oct 23 20:31:12 notify-router DEBUG POST /v1/pages 413 0.06s content-length=523412 src=integration-x
Oct 23 20:31:13 pager-proxy WARN  upstream returned 413 for ticket=abc-123 user=acct-789
```
Maya: we shipped attachment-flagging earlier today (adds metadata flags + inlined preview blobs for certain attachments). suspect it's inlining base64 previews and blowing up size.
Ops-Leah: ohhh. that would explain large Content-Lengths. can we turn the flagging off quickly?
Alex (SRE): i can flip the feature flag in the integration service to stop inlining previews. doing a hot toggle now.
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-2026-1023 — paging-integration-attachment-overflow (auto-detected 413 surge).
OncallBot: Handing on-call to Alex (SRE) — escalation start 20:34 UTC.
Simon: while Alex toggles, can we enable manual SMS fallback for affected tenants? patching SMS relay for top-5 customers now.
Alex (SRE): manual SMS relay enabled for top-5. temporarily raised max_payload in pager-proxy to 1MB for trusted tenants as a short-term mitigation.
Maya: ops note: customers A, C, and D missed critical pages — we've informed Support to call them and confirm delivery.
Ops-Leah: adding quickplay runbook steps: 1) disable attachment-flagging in integ svc; 2) enable SMS fallback; 3) monitor 413 rate; 4) create follow-up ticket to trim previews server-side.
Simon: Alex any errors after the toggle?
Alex (SRE): errors decreased ~90% in the last 4m. still seeing a few large payloads from legacy integrations — queuing manual triage.
Maya: leaving a short snippet for postmortem: attachment-flagging inlines previews for certain file-types and didn't respect max_preview_size config. preview encoding was base64 which blew up payload.
Alex (SRE): i'll collect logs and spike a fix to stream (not inline) previews and add a reject rule at 300k. scheduling postmortem 1pm PT tomorrow.
incidentbot: INC-2026-1023 updated — severity: high -> mitigated, notes: feature-flagged-off, manual SMS fallback enabled.
Ops-Leah: thanks team — can we also add telemetry to count "inlined_preview_bytes" per page request? would help detect recurrence.
Simon: agreed. also add a regression test that ensures notify-router returns 413 for payloads > configured max.
Maya: support notified customers with ETA and manual calls are in progress. will update the incident doc with customer impact list.
Alex (SRE): closing the live triage — mitigation in place. follow-ups assigned: INTF-1124 (trim previews), INTF-1125 (telemetry), INTF-1126 (regression tests).
Maya: thanks all. :thumbsup:
